scenes.headline: How one number keeps FP8 attention honest
scenes.sub: Delta-Matching: Tang, Kang, Cai, Han and Xiong
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Fenwick! Eight-bit attention training can drift for a long time unnoticed. Here is the one number the authors fix.

scenes.text: Take the softmax correction from the same rounded numbers the gradient uses, and every row of the gradient sums to zero again.
scenes.say: Take the correction from the same rounded numbers the gradient uses, and each gradient row sums to zero again.

scenes.title: The softmax backward, row by row
scenes.text: dS = P * (dP - delta), delta = sum(P * dP)
scenes.say: In exact arithmetic this row always sums to zero. The question is which delta you subtract.

parts.note: zero row sum only if delta matches
parts.say: The score gradient subtracts a delta from each row. The row sums to zero only if that delta matches the row's own numbers.

parts.note: built from P and dP, not the stored output
parts.say: Delta-Matching builds delta from the probabilities and the gradient it just rounded, not the saved output.

left.title: The usual shortcut
items: delta from the saved BF16 output
rounding mismatches stay in the row sum
left.say: The usual shortcut reads delta from the saved output, so every rounding mismatch stays in the row sum.

right.title: Delta-Matching
items: delta from P times the rounded gradient
row sum zero at FP32 round-off
right.say: Delta-Matching builds delta from the probabilities and the rounded gradient. The row sum is zero at float thirty-two round-off.

scenes.title: One extra pass in the backward

steps.say: The forward pass runs in eight-bit floats and stores the output in BF16.
The backward pass first recomputes the probabilities and the gradient, and forms the matched delta from them.
Only then does it build the score gradient, and from it the key, value and query gradients.

scenes.label: row sum of dS with the stale delta, one toy row
scenes.note: matched delta: zero at FP32 round-off
scenes.say: In a toy row I ran, the stale delta leaves a row sum of minus zero point zero three one eight. The matched delta leaves almost nothing.

scenes.title: Validation loss at 5.29B parameters
scenes.note: reported by the paper, two seeds
scenes.say: The paper reports that at five point two nine billion parameters the stale shortcut ends far above the reference, and Delta-Matching stays on it.

scenes.text: A zero row sum is a cheap check that a low-precision attention backward pass is still consistent.
scenes.say: A zero row sum is a cheap check that a low precision attention backward is consistent.

recap: The stale delta leaves a nonzero row sum.
The matched delta restores zero before the cast.
The price is one extra pass.
scenes.say: The stale delta leaves a nonzero row sum. The matched delta restores zero before the cast, for one extra pass.
